messages:
Alex Kim: Quick design review — putting up the latest mock for the deployments timeline slider: canary allocation breakpoints + copy. Looking for UX + a11y + copy input. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/canary-allocation-01.png
Marta Varga: Nice! Two quick things: slider track contrast is pretty low against white, likely fails WCAG AA for non-text controls. Also the label 'Canary traffic' reads vague — maybe 'Canary allocation' or 'Traffic split'?
Jon Park: Implementation note: the current slider is custom and uses a lightweight canvas for ticks. Adding a heavier track color is easy, but we should be mindful of hit targets — increasing thumb size might be better than just darkening the track.
a11y-bot: automated check: slider track contrast ratio = 2.9:1 (FAIL for interactive controls). Recommended target >= 3:1 per WCAG 2.1 for controls.
Alex Kim: good catch — I darkened the track in the new frame and added a 2px outline on focus. Also added a small tooltip showing percentage on drag. Proposed keyboard behaviour: arrow keys ±1%, shift+arrow ±10%. Here's the aria idea: `role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="10" aria-label="Canary allocation percentage"`
Marta Varga: Tooltip looks helpful, but on mobile the tooltip overlaps the version markers on the left. Can we float it above the thumb and use a subtle drop shadow so it doesn't feel cramped? Also prefer the copy 'allocation' over 'traffic' — clearer.
Jon Park: I'll prototype an absolute-positioned tooltip with `transform: translateX(-50%)` to center it and `pointer-events: none` so it doesn't steal taps. Quick CSS mock: ``` .slider-thumb { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .slider-track { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .slider-thumb:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,112,244,0.12); outline: none; } ```
Sarah Lee: Copy nit: for the rollout flow we often say 'allocation' in docs, so lets standardize on 'Canary allocation'. Can we show the numeric % next to the label when a non-zero canary exists (e.g., "Canary allocation — 10%")? Also proposing an experiment: A/B test label 'Allocation' vs 'Split' to see which reduces confusion for new users.
Alex Kim: updated mock pushed to the board with darker track, bigger thumb, keyboard hints, and label variant 'Canary allocation — 10%'. Also added aria attributes to the HTML mock.
Marta Varga: Looks much better visually and a11y-wise :thumbsup:. One more nit: focus ring color is our blue but low contrast on the dark track when thumb is focused — can we use a white inner ring + colored outer ring for clarity?
Jon Park: yep, doable. I'll try a dual-ring approach (white 2px inner + 4px blue outer). I can throw up a quick demo on staging later today.
Sarah Lee: Thank you all. I'll add the A/B experiment to the roadmap (2 weeks) and file a follow-up to measure support tickets/first-time completion. If Jon can demo the staging prototype, we can ship the track contrast + keyboard affordances in the next patch.
Alex Kim: perfect — tagging @Marta for final copy review once staging is up. Closing this thread for now, will reopen if anything else pops up.
